book: Volume of three works printed in London in 1690: Ussher's Latin Historia dogmatica on Scripture and vernacular versions (dedication, preface, contents, ten chapters, two dissertations), Henry Wharton's Auctarium (eight chapters and addenda), and a back-matter index.
